text:
Alex: Morning async — quick checkin for today. TL;DR: audits + KMS dry-run prep + IAM cleanup. What I did: triaged ENGSEC-4821, found an aliased KMS key that wasn't rotated; created ENGSEC-4830 to track rotation dry-run. Vulnerability sweep flagged libfoo v1.2.3 in inference-runtime container (low→medium) — opened draft PR. Started IAM review for 'devops-temp' roles (should be safe to remove long-lived permissions). Blockers: need a rotation window approved by @Priya, and staging dry-run is failing with kv-cache timeouts (stack trace pasted below). Today: finish PRs, run KMS dry-run with @Dana pairing, and push IAM cleanup change to staging for canary. Ping @Marta for compliance doc update.

Priya: acked — can approve rotation window but need runbook link and expected downtime. Can we target Tue 10pm PT? :calendar:

Alex: putting runbook in this thread in a sec. Expected: <5min soft-reload, fallback to older key for 1hr. No customer-facing outage expected, but internal retries will spike. If Tue 10pm PT works I'll mark ENGSEC-4830.

Dana: I can pair on the dry-run. Alex, can you share the failing logs for the kv-cache timeout? I can reproduce locally if you paste the snippet.

Alex: pasted logs:
```
2026-03-12T02:07:14Z runtime[worker-3]: kv-cache: get(prefix=abc123) -> timeout after 2500ms
2026-03-12T02:07:14Z runtime[worker-3]: fallback to uncached path, latency +120ms
2026-03-12T02:07:15Z runtime[worker-3]: kube-client 504 on curl -> retry
```

Dana: hmm looks like the memcached pod had a cold restart during the test. I'll check pod events and bump memcached resources in staging.

Sanjay: QA flagged an e2e flake around tokenization with the new libfoo patch — created TEST-971 and assigned to me. I can toggle prefix-cache in staging to see if that stabilizes the e2e while we patch libfoo.

Alex: thanks @Sanjay — please leave the test link here when you have it. I will add a canary config to reduce batch size for staging during the dry-run to reduce pressure on KV.

Marta: quick compliance note — for the rotation runbook we need an audit log section that shows: who initiated, KMS key versions before/after, and rollback timestamp. I'll update the template and drop it in ENGSEC-4830.

Alex: perfect — @Marta if you add the audit snippet I'll link it in the runbook.

Marta: added snippet to ENGSEC-4830: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENGSEC-4830 (see attachments).

Alex: opened PRs: PR#6183 (libfoo bump, draft) and PR#6184 (IAM cleanup for devops-temp). PR links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6183 and /pull/6184. Requesting reviews from @Priya and @Dana.

Priya: will review PR#6184 tonight. For PR#6183 can you add a short changelog entry and a risk assessment?

Alex: done — added changelog + risk note in PR description.

sec-bot: ENGSEC-4830 status changed -> In Progress (assignee: Alex). :robot_face:

Dana: I'll start pairing at 9:30am PT to run the dry-run in staging. Alex, share a Zoom / screenshare link when you’re ready.

Sanjay: TEST-971 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TEST-971 — I'm going to try prefix-cache toggle and report results by EOD.

Alex: latest: reduced staging batch size from 128 -> 32 for canary, scheduled dry-run Tue 10pm PT, ETA for PR reviews EOD. If anyone hits blockers DM me. Thanks all :thumbsup:
